kits.title: Blue Pencil Revision Mini Kit
kits.parentNote: Use this as a short, low-pressure revision session after a child already has a rough draft.
kits.classroomExtension: Run three silent rating rounds for pace, repeated details, and clarity before students choose one edit pass.
kits.upsell: Companion option: add the $29 homeschool revision bundle with extra drafts, peer review cards, and weekly writing routines.

kits.title: Clue Label Gallery Pack
kits.parentNote: Use this when a child needs a concrete object-based way to write one clear explanation.
kits.classroomExtension: Set up table galleries where students sort object clues, write one exhibit label, and expand it into a short paragraph.
kits.upsell: Companion option: add the $79 classroom writing-process license for rubrics, station signs, and reusable showcase templates.

kits.title: Binding Day Classroom License Pack
kits.parentNote: Use this at the end of a writing unit when the goal is finishing, organizing, and sharing work clearly.
kits.classroomExtension: Turn the room into a publishing boardwalk with stations for page order, blurbs, author notes, and final reflection.
kits.upsell: Companion option: add seasonal classroom packs that reuse the same publishing checklist with new world themes.
